title: QMNF Formalization Project Blueprint
main_goal: Complete formalization of all 64+ QMNF innovations with 100% proof coverage
context: QMNF (Quantum Modular Number Field) is a unified mathematical framework combining modular arithmetic, golden ratio rings, Apollonian gaskets, and post-quantum cryptography

nodes.label: Prime Modulus Definition
nodes.statement: For natural number M: Prime(M) ≡ M > 1 ∧ (∀ d : ℕ, d | M → d = 1 ∨ d = M)

nodes.label: Modular Integer Type Definition
nodes.statement: For prime M: ℤ_M := { x : ℤ | 0 ≤ x < M } with modular operations

nodes.label: Modular Operations Definition
nodes.statement: For a, b ∈ ℤ_M: add_mod(a, b) := (a + b) mod M, mul_mod(a, b) := (a × b) mod M, sub_mod(a, b) := (a - b + M) mod M, neg_mod(a) := (M - a) mod M

nodes.label: QPhi Element Definition
nodes.statement: For prime M: QPhi_M := { (a, b) | a, b ∈ ℤ_M } representing a + b×φ where φ² = φ + 1

nodes.label: Curvature Tuple Definition
nodes.statement: For prime M: CurvatureTuple_M := { (k₁, k₂, k₃, k₄) ∈ ℤ_M⁴ | (k₁ + k₂ + k₃ + k₄)² = 2(k₁² + k₂² + k₃² + k₄²) mod M }

nodes.label: QMNF Rational Definition
nodes.statement: For prime M: QMNFRational_M := { (n, d) ∈ ℤ_M × ℤ_M | d ≠ 0 ∧ gcd(n, d) = 1 ∧ d > 0 }

nodes.label: Integer Purity Axiom
nodes.statement: ∀ x ∈ ComputationalDomain: typeof(x) ∈ {Int64, Int128} ∧ ¬∃ f : Float. f participates_in computation(x)

nodes.label: Modular Closure Axiom
nodes.statement: ∀ op ∈ {add_mod, mul_mod, sub_mod, neg_mod}: ∀ a, b ∈ ℤ_M: op(a, b) ∈ ℤ_M

nodes.label: Deterministic Reproducibility Axiom
nodes.statement: ∀ f : ℤ_M^n → ℤ_M^m, ∀ x ∈ ℤ_M^n: ∀ platforms P₁, P₂, ∀ times t₁, t₂: eval(f, x, P₁, t₁) = eval(f, x, P₂, t₂)

nodes.label: Modular Closure Under Addition
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a, b ∈ ℤ_M: add_mod(a, b) ∈ ℤ_M

nodes.label: Modular Closure Under Multiplication
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a, b ∈ ℤ_M: mul_mod(a, b) ∈ ℤ_M

nodes.label: Additive Commutativity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a, b ∈ ℤ_M: add_mod(a, b) = add_mod(b, a)

nodes.label: Multiplicative Commutativity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a, b ∈ ℤ_M: mul_mod(a, b) = mul_mod(b, a)

nodes.label: Additive Associativity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a, b, c ∈ ℤ_M: add_mod(add_mod(a, b), c) = add_mod(a, add_mod(b, c))

nodes.label: Multiplicative Associativity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a, b, c ∈ ℤ_M: mul_mod(mul_mod(a, b), c) = mul_mod(a, mul_mod(b, c))

nodes.label: Additive Identity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a ∈ ℤ_M: add_mod(a, 0) = a ∧ add_mod(0, a) = a

nodes.label: Multiplicative Identity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a ∈ ℤ_M: mul_mod(a, 1) = a ∧ mul_mod(1, a) = a

nodes.label: Additive Inverse Existence
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a ∈ ℤ_M: ∃! a' ∈ ℤ_M: add_mod(a, a') = 0

nodes.label: Multiplicative Inverse Existence - Fermat
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a ∈ ℤ_M, a ≠ 0: ∃! a⁻¹ ∈ ℤ_M: mul_mod(a, a⁻¹) = 1

nodes.label: Distributivity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a, b, c ∈ ℤ_M: mul_mod(a, add_mod(b, c)) = add_mod(mul_mod(a, b), mul_mod(a, c))

nodes.label: Complete Field Structure
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → (ℤ_M, add_mod, mul_mod, 0, 1, neg_mod, inv_mod) is a field

nodes.label: Extended GCD Definition
nodes.statement: extended_gcd : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ where extended_gcd(a, b) = (g, x, y) with g = gcd(a, b) and a × x + b × y = g (Bézout's identity)

nodes.label: Extended Euclidean Algorithm
nodes.statement: function extended_gcd(a: ℤ, b: ℤ) → (g: ℤ, x: ℤ, y: ℤ): if b = 0: return (a, 1, 0) else: (g, x', y') := extended_gcd(b, a mod b); return (g, y', x' - (a ÷ b) × y')

nodes.label: Extended GCD Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ a, b ∈ ℤ, b ≠ 0: let (g, x, y) = extended_gcd(a, b) in g = gcd(a, b) ∧ a × x + b × y = g

nodes.label: Modular Inverse via Extended GCD
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ a ∈ ℤ_M, a ≠ 0: let (_, x, _) = extended_gcd(a, M) in (x mod M) × a ≡ 1 (mod M)

nodes.label: Extended GCD Complexity
nodes.statement: ∀ a, b ∈ ℤ, a ≥ b > 0: Time(extended_gcd(a, b)) = O(log(min(a, b)))

nodes.label: QMNF Rational Type Definition
nodes.statement: QMNFRational_M := { (n, d) ∈ ℤ_M × ℤ_M | d ≠ 0 ∧ gcd(n, d) = 1 ∧ d > 0 } with equivalence: (n₁, d₁) ~ (n₂, d₂) iff n₁ × d₂ ≡ n₂ × d₁ (mod M)

nodes.label: Canonical Form Existence
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ n ∈ ℤ, d ∈ ℤ, d ≠ 0: ∃! (n', d') ∈ QMNFRational_M: n × d' ≡ n' × d (mod M) ∧ gcd(n', d') = 1 ∧ d' > 0

nodes.label: Rational Addition Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ r₁, r₂ ∈ QMNFRational_M: (n₁/d₁) ⊕ (n₂/d₂) := canonical(n₁×d₂ + n₂×d₁, d₁×d₂, M) represents the mathematical sum (n₁/d₁) + (n₂/d₂)

nodes.label: Rational Multiplication Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ r₁, r₂ ∈ QMNFRational_M: (n₁/d₁) ⊗ (n₂/d₂) := canonical(n₁×n₂, d₁×d₂, M) represents the mathematical product (n₁/d₁) × (n₂/d₂)

nodes.label: Rational Division Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ r₁, r₂ ∈ QMNFRational_M, r₂ ≠ 0: (n₁/d₁) ⊘ (n₂/d₂) := canonical(n₁×d₂, d₁×n₂, M) represents the mathematical quotient (n₁/d₁) ÷ (n₂/d₂)

nodes.label: Rational Field Structure
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → (QMNFRational_M, ⊕, ⊗) is a field

nodes.label: Sequence Boundedness
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ f : ℤ_M → ℤ_M, ∀ x₀ ∈ ℤ_M: let S = {xₙ | x₀, xₙ₊₁ = f(xₙ)} in S ⊆ ℤ_M ∧ |S| ≤ M

nodes.label: Eventual Periodicity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ f : ℤ_M → ℤ_M, ∀ x₀ ∈ ℤ_M: ∃ p, t ∈ ℕ, p ≤ M, t ≤ M: ∀ n ≥ t: x_{n+p} = xₙ

nodes.label: Resource Bound
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ algorithm A operating on ℤ_M: Space(A) = O(M × word_size) and Time_per_step(A) = O(polylog(M))

nodes.label: QPhi Operations Definition
nodes.statement: Addition: (a₁, b₁) ⊕ (a₂, b₂) := ((a₁ + a₂) mod M, (b₁ + b₂) mod M); Multiplication: (a₁, b₁) ⊗ (a₂, b₂) := ((a₁a₂ + b₁b₂) mod M, (a₁b₂ + b₁a₂ + b₁b₂) mod M) using φ² = φ + 1

nodes.label: QPhi Multiplication Derivation
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ (a₁, b₁), (a₂, b₂) ∈ QPhi_M: (a₁ + b₁φ) × (a₂ + b₂φ) = (a₁a₂ + b₁b₂) + (a₁b₂ + b₁a₂ + b₁b₂)φ

nodes.label: QPhi Identity Preservation
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → (0, 1) ⊗ (0, 1) = (1, 1) (representing φ² = φ + 1)

nodes.label: QPhi Norm Definition
nodes.statement: N : QPhi_M → ℤ_M defined as N(a, b) := (a² + a×b - b²) mod M

nodes.label: Norm Multiplicativity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ q₁, q₂ ∈ QPhi_M: N(q₁ ⊗ q₂) = N(q₁) × N(q₂) mod M

nodes.label: QPhi Conjugate Definition
nodes.statement: conj : QPhi_M → QPhi_M defined as conj(a, b) := ((a + b) mod M, (-b) mod M)

nodes.label: Conjugate Identity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ q ∈ QPhi_M: q ⊗ conj(q) = (N(q), 0)

nodes.label: QPhi Inverse Existence
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ q ∈ QPhi_M, N(q) ≠ 0: ∃! q⁻¹ ∈ QPhi_M: q ⊗ q⁻¹ = (1, 0)

nodes.label: QPhi Ring Structure
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → (QPhi_M, ⊕, ⊗) is a commutative ring with unity

nodes.label: Fibonacci Representation
nodes.statement: ∀ n ∈ ℕ: φⁿ = Fₙ × φ + F_{n-1} where F₀ = 0, F₁ = 1, Fₙ = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}; equivalently in QPhi: (0, 1)^n = (F_{n-1} mod M, Fₙ mod M)

nodes.label: Fast Fibonacci Algorithm via QPhi
nodes.statement: function fibonacci(n: ℕ, M: ℕ) → ℤ_M: if n = 0: return 0; if n = 1: return 1; result := (1, 0); base := (0, 1); while n > 0: if n mod 2 = 1: result := result ⊗ base; base := base ⊗ base; n := n ÷ 2; return result.b

nodes.label: Fast Fibonacci Algorithm Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ n ∈ ℕ: fibonacci(n, M) = Fₙ mod M

nodes.label: Fast Fibonacci Algorithm Complexity
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, ∀ n ∈ ℕ: Time(fibonacci(n, M)) = O(log(n) × log²(M))

nodes.label: Descartes Circle Theorem Definition
nodes.statement: Descartes(k₁, k₂, k₃, k₄) ≡ (k₁ + k₂ + k₃ + k₄)² = 2(k₁² + k₂² + k₃² + k₄²) mod M

nodes.label: Modular Preservation of Descartes Relation
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ k₁, k₂, k₃, k₄ ∈ ℤ satisfying Descartes in ℤ: (k₁ mod M, k₂ mod M, k₃ mod M, k₄ mod M) satisfies Descartes in ℤ_M

nodes.label: Reflection Operation Definition
nodes.statement: reflect : CurvatureTuple_M × {0,1,2,3} → CurvatureTuple_M where reflect((k₁, k₂, k₃, k₄), i) returns tuple with kᵢ replaced by k'ᵢ = 2(sum of other three) - kᵢ

nodes.label: Reflection Preserves Descartes
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ T ∈ CurvatureTuple_M, ∀ i ∈ {0,1,2,3}: reflect(T, i) ∈ CurvatureTuple_M

nodes.label: Orbit Finiteness
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ seed ∈ CurvatureTuple_M: let O = orbit(seed) in |O| ≤ M⁴

nodes.label: Orbit Cycle
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → ∀ seed ∈ CurvatureTuple_M: ∃ period p ≤ M⁴: orbit eventually cycles with period p

nodes.label: Apollonian-Fibonacci Correspondence
nodes.statement: The Apollonian sequence generated from seed (-1, 2, 2, 3) under repeated reflection at index 0 produces curvatures related to Fibonacci/Lucas numbers: k_n = L_{n+2} - 1

nodes.label: ℤ[φ] Embedding of Apollonian Sequences
nodes.statement: ∀ M : ℕ, Prime(M) → Apollonian sequences embed into QPhi_M with preserved structure

nodes.label: Ring-LWE Distribution Definition
nodes.statement: RLWE_{s,χ} : Distribution over R_q × R_q where R = ℤ[X]/(X^N + 1), R_q = R/qR = ℤ_q[X]/(X^N + 1), sample (a, b) with a ← U(R_q), e ← χ_σ(R), b = -a·s + e

nodes.label: Ring-LWE Hardness Assumption
nodes.statement: ∀ PPT adversary A, ∀ sufficiently large security parameter λ: |Pr[A(a, b) = 1 | (a, b) ← RLWE_{s,χ}] - Pr[A(a, b) = 1 | (a, b) ← U(R_q²)]| < negl(λ)

nodes.label: Ring-LWE Security Reduction
nodes.statement: RLWE security reduces to hardness of worst-case lattice problems: SVP (Shortest Vector Problem) on ideal lattices with approximation factor γ = poly(N)

nodes.label: BFV-style Encryption Definition
nodes.statement: KeyGen(): s ← χ_σ(R), a ← U(R_q), e ← χ_σ(R), pk = (a, b = -a·s + e), sk = s; Encrypt(pk, m ∈ R_t): r ← χ_σ(R), e₁, e₂ ← χ_σ(R), c₀ = a·r + e₁, c₁ = b·r + e₂ + ⌊q/t⌋·m; Decrypt(sk, ct): ⌊(t/q)·(c₀·s + c₁)⌉ mod t

nodes.label: Decryption Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ m ∈ R_t: Decrypt(sk, Encrypt(pk, m)) = m provided error ||e₁·s - e·r + e₂|| < q/(2t)

nodes.label: K-Elimination Configuration
nodes.statement: DualCodexConfig := { α_cap : ℕ, β_cap : ℕ, α_pos : α_cap > 1, β_pos : β_cap > 1, coprime : Nat.Coprime α_cap β_cap } with totalModulus = α_cap * β_cap

nodes.label: Dual-Codex Value Definition
nodes.statement: DualCodexValue cfg := { v_α : ZMod cfg.α_cap, v_β : ZMod cfg.β_cap } representing value V where V ≡ v_α (mod α_cap) and V ≡ v_β (mod β_cap)

nodes.label: Overflow Quotient Definition
nodes.statement: For value V and modulus α_cap: overflowQuotient(V) := V ÷ α_cap and residue(V) := V mod α_cap, with V = residue(V) + overflowQuotient(V) * α_cap

nodes.label: K-Elimination Theorem
nodes.statement: ∀ V : ℕ, V < totalModulus cfg: let v_α = (V : ZMod cfg.α_cap), v_β = (V : ZMod cfg.β_cap), α_inv = (cfg.α_cap : ZMod cfg.β_cap)⁻¹, k_recovered = (v_β - v_α.val) * α_inv; then (k_recovered : ZMod cfg.β_cap) = (overflowQuotient cfg V : ZMod cfg.β_cap)

nodes.label: Exact Value Reconstruction
nodes.statement: ∀ V : ℕ, V < totalModulus cfg: V = residue cfg V + overflowQuotient cfg V * cfg.α_cap

nodes.label: Perfect Accuracy of K-Elimination
nodes.statement: ∀ V : ℕ, V < totalModulus cfg: residue cfg V + overflowQuotient cfg V * cfg.α_cap = V (100% accuracy vs probabilistic methods)

nodes.label: CRT Configuration Definition
nodes.statement: CRTConfig n := { channels : Fin n → ResidueChannel, pairwise_coprime : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (channels i).modulus (channels j).modulus } where ResidueChannel has modulus > 1 and modulus_prime

nodes.label: CRTBigInt Representation
nodes.statement: CRTBigInt cfg := { residues : ∀ i : Fin n, ZMod (cfg.channels i).modulus } representing value V where V ≡ residues i (mod (cfg.channels i).modulus)

nodes.label: CRT Addition Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ a b : CRTBigInt cfg, i : Fin n: (add cfg a b).residues i = a.residues i + b.residues i

nodes.label: CRT Multiplication Correctness
nodes.statement: ∀ a b : CRTBigInt cfg, i : Fin n: (mul cfg a b).residues i = a.residues i * b.residues i

nodes.label: CRT Addition Homomorphism
nodes.statement: ∀ x y : ℤ: fromInt cfg (x + y) = add cfg (fromInt cfg x) (fromInt cfg y)

nodes.label: CRT Multiplication Homomorphism
nodes.statement: ∀ x y : ℤ: fromInt cfg (x * y) = mul cfg (fromInt cfg x) (fromInt cfg y)

nodes.label: CRT Unique Representation
nodes.statement: ∀ V : ℕ, V < totalModulus cfg: ∃! (crv : CRTBigInt cfg), ∀ i, crv.residues i = (V : ZMod (cfg.channels i).modulus)

nodes.label: CRT Operation Correspondence
nodes.statement: ∀ Va Vb : ℕ, hVa : Va < totalModulus cfg, hVb : Vb < totalModulus cfg: let a := fromInt cfg Va, b := fromInt cfg Vb; ∀ i: (add cfg a b).residues i = ((Va + Vb : ℕ) : ZMod (cfg.channels i).modulus) and (mul cfg a b).residues i = ((Va * Vb : ℕ) : ZMod (cfg.channels i).modulus)

nodes.label: Fibonacci Coprimality
nodes.statement: ∀ n : ℕ: Nat.Coprime (fibonacciModulus n) (fibonacciModulus (n + 1)) where fibonacciModulus 0 = 21, fibonacciModulus 1 = 34, fibonacciModulus (n + 2) = fibonacciModulus n + fibonacciModulus (n + 1)

nodes.label: Modular Inverse Correctness
nodes.statement: modInverse_correct {M : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime M)] (a : ZMod M) (ha : a ≠ 0): a * a⁻¹ = 1

nodes.label: QPhi Additive Commutativity
nodes.statement: qphi_add_comm (cfg : ModConfig) (q1 q2 : qphi cfg): qphi_add cfg q1 q2 = qphi_add cfg q2 q1

nodes.label: QPhi Multiplicative Commutativity
nodes.statement: qphi_mul_comm (cfg : ModConfig) (q1 q2 : qphi cfg): qphi_mul cfg q1 q2 = qphi_mul cfg q2 q1

nodes.label: QPhi Additive Associativity
nodes.statement: qphi_add_assoc (cfg : ModConfig) (q1 q2 q3 : qphi cfg): (qphi_add cfg q1 q2) q3 = qphi_add cfg q1 (qphi_add cfg q2 q3)

nodes.label: QPhi Multiplicative Associativity
nodes.statement: qphi_mul_assoc (cfg : ModConfig) (q1 q2 q3 : qphi cfg): (qphi_mul cfg q1 q2) q3 = qphi_mul cfg q1 (qphi_mul cfg q2 q3)

nodes.label: QPhi Left Distributivity
nodes.statement: qphi_left_distrib (cfg : ModConfig) (q1 q2 q3 : qphi cfg): qphi_mul cfg q1 (qphi_add cfg q2 q3) = qphi_add cfg (qphi_mul cfg q1 q2) (qphi_mul cfg q1 q3)

nodes.label: QPhi Right Distributivity
nodes.statement: qphi_right_distrib (cfg : ModConfig) (q1 q2 q3 : qphi cfg): qphi_mul cfg (qphi_add cfg q1 q2) q3 = qphi_add cfg (qphi_mul cfg q1 q3) (qphi_mul cfg q2 q3)

nodes.label: Binary GCD Correctness
nodes.statement: binaryGCD_correct (a b : ℕ): binaryGCD a b = gcd a b

nodes.label: Extended Binary GCD Bézout Identity
nodes.statement: extendedBinaryGCD_bezout (a b : ℕ): let (g, x, y) = extendedBinaryGCD a b in a * x + b * y = g

nodes.label: NTT Primitive Root Existence
nodes.statement: ntt_exists (N : ℕ) (hN : N > 0) (q : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime q)] (hq : q % (2 * N) = 1): ∃ ω : ZMod q, PrimitiveRoot N ω

nodes.statement: All Lean files compile without 'sorry' statements

nodes.statement: All Coq files compile without 'Admitted' statements

nodes.statement: All security properties from 04_Security_Proofs.md are formally verified
